message.content: Hey, I’m staring at my fridge and I have no idea what to make for dinner. I’ve got a tin of tomatoes, some spinach, and half an onion. Also, I think I need to restock on milk and eggs because I’m completely out.

content.text: That sounds like the start of a quick pasta dish. Since you have tomatoes and spinach, we could do a simple arrabbiata or just a fresh tomato sauce. Do you have any pasta in the cupboard? Also, I can add milk and eggs to your weekly shopping list if you’d like.

message.content: Yes, I have penne. Let’s do the tomato sauce. And yes, please add those to the list. Can you also add a loaf of sourdough? I need it for tomorrow morning with my coffee.

content.text: Added. Here is the updated list for your Saturday shop: Milk, Eggs, Sourdough loaf. For the sauce, do you have garlic, olive oil, salt, pepper, and maybe some chili flakes or dried oregano?

message.content: I have the oil, salt, pepper, and chili flakes. No garlic though. Should I add that to the list too?

content.text: Yes, definitely. Garlic is essential for the base flavor. I’ve added one bulb of garlic to the list. So your full list is: Milk, Eggs, Sourdough loaf, Garlic bulb. Want me to send this to your phone so you can just tick it off at the store?

message.content: That would be great. Once I’m back, help me with the cooking steps? I want to make sure I don’t burn the onion.

content.text: Will do. When you get home, just let me know. I’ll guide you through sweating the onion and garlic first, then adding the tomatoes, and finally the spinach so it just wilts rather than overcooks. See you at the store, or whenever you get back.
